title: Induction Motor
text: Three-phase induction motor, 3 inputs, 4 outputs; {Simulation type} selects simulation type, {Sample time, Ts} sets the sample time for discrete integration, {Port configuration} selects port configuration, {Number of pole pairs, P} sets the pole pairs, {Stator resistance and leakage inductance, Zs} sets the resistance and inductance, {Rotor resistance and leakage inductance, Zr} sets the resistance and inductance, {Magnetizing inductance, Lm} sets the inductance, {Physical inertia, viscous damping, static friction, mechanical} sets the inertia, damping, friction, {Initial mechanical position, theta_init} sets the angular position and {Initial mechanical speed, omega_init} sets the angular speed. Values come from the instance.
